key_point: The real-life inspiration for the Clickers
title: The real-life inspiration for the Clickers
caption: The Last of Us infection was inspired by a real ant-controlling fungus shown in BBC's Planet Earth. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #thelastofus #naughtydog

instagram.caption:
The fungus in The Last of Us is based on a real one, Ophiocordyceps, which infects ants and controls their bodies.

Neil Druckmann saw it in a BBC Planet Earth segment: the ant climbs high, dies, and a stalk grows out of its head.

He wondered what would happen if it jumped to humans. That idea became Joel and Ellie's world.

Was the game or the show scarier?
